title: Self-Tor conormal normalization predicate
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I and n, IsSelfTorConormalComparison A I n c is the Koszul normalization predicate on a morphism from [new-r4-conormal-exterior-module] to self-Tor. It universally quantifies over finite ideal tuples, resolutions, augmentation-preserving chain lifts, wedge inputs and cycle preimages, and equates the image under c and the resolution isomorphism with the homology image of the Koszul cycle under the chain lift. The Koszul complex is [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex].

proof.text: This definition is the foundational construction used by the parent comparison argument.
